name: You've been ReMaid!
storyline:
Welcome to Hotel Goetia. A mansion shrouded in mystery that even the locals won't come near! In this light-hearted game of cat and mouse, prepare to be chased around every corner by the most unlikely of main antagonists – adorable yet relentless maids! Only they don't just clean the house, they're also more than willing to open a can of whoopass on you if you intend to cause trouble in their workplace!

Begin the adventure as a traveller stopping at the village at the bottom of the mountain, stock up on supplies and make your way to the mansion before the guards decide to detain you. Then uncover the mansion's dark past, reveal hidden secrets, and get to the bottom of what really happened there. Dive into a captivating story filled with twists and turns that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Will you get to the bottom of this mystery or become another undead resident?
summary: Run for your life as you try to survive the night while being stalked by a cute maid who is dead set on teaching you some manners. Uncover secrets, outsmart your enemies, and embrace the absurd. Will you make it through the night?
